solutions.title: Start at every node
solutions.strategy: For each node, count target-sum paths that start there, then recurse into both children as new starts.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node can be included in counts for each ancestor on its path.

solutions.title: Prefix-sum counts
solutions.strategy: Track prefix sums on the current root-to-node path and count prior prefixes that form the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node performs constant map work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The prefix map contains sums on the current path.
